== Description ==

[[Matt Thornton]] (main subject, tan cap with a yellow Rebel Alliance patch, thick beard, black fleece over a blue Death Star tee, name tag “Matt / …”), [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (right foreground, navy New Era cap, tattooed left forearm, black hoodie, red card sleeves, back to the camera), and [[Steve Harpster]] (right, white hair, white beard, glasses, black jacket, looking toward the table) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
